mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_alert WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_alert (warehouse_id, sku_id, available_stock, safety_stock, status, triggered_at, resolved_at) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{skuId}, #{availableStock}, #{safetyStock}, #{status}, #{triggeredAt}, #{resolvedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_alert SET available_stock = #{availableStock}, safety_stock = #{safetyStock}, status = #{status}, triggered_at = #{triggeredAt}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
